name: smrt-saas-starter
description: Canonical HappyVertical SMRT multi-tenant SaaS starter, reference app, and ecosystem demo.

scripts.test:e2e:production: pnpm build && pnpm run runtime:prepare && node scripts/run-production-e2e.mjs
scripts.db:profiles:backfill: pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @happyvertical/smrt-saas-web run db:profiles:backfill
scripts.db:seed: pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @happyvertical/smrt-saas-web run db:seed
scripts.db:smoke: pnpm run db:seed && pnpm --filter @happyvertical/smrt-saas-web run db:smoke
scripts.check: pnpm run deps:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm run db:smoke && pnpm run workflows:check && pnpm run manifests:check && pnpm run sops:check && pnpm validate
scripts.runtime:check: pnpm build && pnpm run runtime:prepare && pnpm run images:build && pnpm run images:smoke && pnpm run manifests:render
scripts.mobile:validate:native: pnpm run mobile:validate:android && pnpm run mobile:validate:ios
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && lefthook install || echo 'Skipping lefthook install (not in git repository)'
